## Planned

```{r}
rs_table(data.frame(
  Implementation = c("GNU R", "rcp", "Ř (PIR)", "FastR"),
  Kind = c("reference interpreter (AST + byte code)", "copy-and-patch JIT (R package on a patched GNU R)",
           "optimising JIT", "GraalVM / Truffle"),
  `Base GNU R` = c("–", "4.x (same as the patched tree)", "4.1.1 (pinned image)", "own"),
  Driver = c("drivers/timing.py", "to be written", "to be written", "to be written"),
  Status = c(as.character(status("validated")), "planned", "planned", "planned"),
  check.names = FALSE),
  columns = list(Status = colDef(html = TRUE)), pagination = FALSE, sortable = FALSE)
```

::: {.rs-notes}
- Each implementation will be compared with its own versions and options, and with the GNU R release it is built on, using the same benchmarks, machine and harness.
- Every driver builds on r-benchmarks' `rbench` module, so an implementation changes only what makes it different (its command line, harness or environment) and the rest of the measurement is the same.
:::
